# EDA

The figures below come from the exploratory analysis of the cleaned claim-level data (script `EDA/EDA.py`, output in `EDA/figures_v2/`). Each observation is an individual claim in FEMA Region 4, not a tract-year count, and the figures were produced for an earlier severity framing of the project. Their titles and labels are in French.
